payload.text: Issue Ied61fb9 (XS, rides the next cut, devbin-vc): molt upgrade --no-pull still pulls the stack when the Doom config lives in it. On molt-vc's word in its GO for the ccstatusline slot (read by 17:05Z by date -u), dc builds the fix the issue names on its own branch from v1.4.13 (85a0e7eb), in a worktree under $TMPDIR/molt-wt, with one test in test/liberators/editors.bats. Proof: one P0 bats ask, READY to molt-vc, run only on the GO it passes on.
